build_autoregressive_model: build a TeacherForcingAutoregressiveModel with MLP latent system and configurable recurrent dynamics core
train_autoregressive_model: train the autoregressive model using teacher forcing with negative log-likelihood loss on sequence data
reconstruct_sequence: reconstruct an input sequence by encoding, unrolling latent dynamics, and decoding latents
unroll_latent_dynamics: unroll latent dynamics forward using a recurrent core to predict future latent states
compute_ground_truth_latents: compute ground truth state and matching input and output latents for a sequence
